summaryZh: Engle 实验室研究胰腺癌的早期检测与治疗，寻找可区分胰腺癌和其他炎症状态的标志物。团队采用类器官、干细胞技术、生物化学与基因工程小鼠模型，研究疾病机制并评估治疗靶点。
researchQuestions: CA19-9升高通过哪些途径促进胰腺炎和胰腺肿瘤形成？

evidence.quote: The Engle Laboratory focuses on the early detection and treatment of pancreatic cancer.

The organoid models employ stem-cell techniques to create more accurate models of pancreatitis and pancreatic cancer, as well as biochemistry methodology to identify biomarkers that unambiguously differentiate between pancreatic cancer and other inflammatory conditions.
Further investigation is required to understand ways through which CA19-9 elevation promotes pancreatitis and pancreatic tumor formation.
